title: End-to-End Machine Learning Workflow | Machine Learning Course #3
short_hook: From raw potatoes to a gourmet AI model.
description:
Welcome to Lesson 3 of our Machine Learning course. In this lesson, we walk through the entire End-to-End Machine Learning Workflow: the journey from raw, messy data all the way to a deployed, working system. In this lesson: Problem Definition, Data Collection, Data Preprocessing, Feature Engineering, Model Training, and Evaluation and Deployment. We break down the intuition using the potato chef analogy and walk through worked examples including a Spam Filter and House Price Prediction. We also go under the hood to see how Linear Regression uses Gradient Descent and matrix multiplications internally. Learn common mistakes like skipping preprocessing and overfitting. Essential viewing for anyone wanting to build real-world AI products. This is lesson 3 of our complete Machine Learning course - watch the full playlist from the beginning.
